import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
import pytest
sys.path.insert(0,"/work/scripts")
from irc_baseline_support import prepare_inputs
from materialize_outcome_score_data import file_sha256,payload_sha256
from projection_transport_steering.reft_training import epoch_batches
p=Path("/work/research/irc-baseline-config-v2.json")
assert file_sha256(p)=="207e37dd9a7bf977378db65e41db53177451ee36a037e8d347beaa99c34a9acf"
c=json.loads(p.read_text())
tokenizer,examples,selection=prepare_inputs(c,Path("/work"),Path("/model/snapshots/b968826d9c46dd6066d109eabc6255188de91218"))
assert len(examples)==1500 and len(selection)==256

assert len(c["candidates"])==8
assert sum(sum(y!=-100 for y in x["labels"][1:]) for x in examples)==356743
for epoch in range(12):
    groups=epoch_batches(examples,c["recipe"]["seed"],epoch,32)
    assert payload_sha256(groups)==c["recipe"]["epoch_order_sha256"][epoch]
    assert sorted(i for group in groups for i in group)==list(range(1500))
    assert len(groups)==47 and len(groups[-1])==28
print(json.dumps({"event":"baseline_exact_preflight","status":"pass","source_count":len(c["source_sha256"]),"fit":1500,"selection":256,"candidates":8,"zero_partition":True,"epochs":12,"updates":564,"target_examples_sha256":payload_sha256(examples),"config_sha256":file_sha256(p)}),flush=True)
